controls.title: AI system inventory
controls.description: Technical subset: presence of a structured component inventory.
controls.limitation: An inventory file does not demonstrate organizational coverage, maintenance, or adequate resources.

controls.title: Intended use and context
controls.description: Technical subset: model use-case metadata and a reviewed context assessment.
controls.limitation: Model metadata alone does not establish context, affected stakeholders, or legal applicability.

controls.title: Evaluation methodology
controls.description: Technical subset: scan output and a documented evaluation methodology.
controls.limitation: Static analysis does not establish model performance, evaluation suitability, or testing coverage.

controls.title: Testing and incident practices
controls.description: Technical subset: testing output plus documented incident procedures.
controls.limitation: A scan does not prove an operational incident process or information sharing.

controls.title: Risk response decisions
controls.description: Technical subset: documented and approved risk response decisions.
controls.limitation: Generic attestations are not interpreted as risk acceptance or authorization decisions.
